methodological_note: The 120-development / 30-holdout protocol was pre-specified before reliability modelling. The exact scenario-ID assignment had not been materialised in the repository. This artefact instantiates that protocol without reference to observed LLM outcomes.
partition_method: Fixed-seed stratified random assignment within each fault x scenario-family stratum. Each of the 15 strata contains 10 scenarios, with 8 assigned to DEVELOPMENT and 2 assigned to HOLDOUT.
substage: A8.7.2 Frozen Modelling Protocol Recovery and Empirical Compatibility Check
